description:
Record money received against threads, stored one file per thread under payments/.

Subcommands:
  log [THREAD] [AMOUNT] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t TIME] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] [--all] — record a receipt; INTERACTIVE if THREAD is omitted
  list [THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread T] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--as-of DATE] [--pdf PATH] [--json] — billed versus received, by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount AMOUNT] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t TIME] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change fields of a payment
  rm ID [-y] — delete a payment

Flags:
  log: -c 3-letter ISO currency, defaults to the thread's; -d date received YYYY-MM-DD, default today; -t time HH:MM, default now; -a which account it landed in; -n free-text note; --all only affects the interactive picker
  list: --since, --until YYYY-MM-DD bounds; --json
  statement: --thread limit to one thread; --since, --until; --as-of statement date YYYY-MM-DD driving aging, default today; --pdf render a PDF to this path, requires --thread; --json
  show: --json
  edit: --amount new amount; -c, -d, -t, -a, -n as for log
  rm: -y skip confirmation

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "15000", "-c", "ZAR", "-a", "Business current"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--as-of", "2026-09-30", "--json"]
  ["rm", "a1b2c3d4", "-y"]

Notes:
  Never call `log` without THREAD and AMOUNT — it falls into an interactive picker reading stdin.
  Amounts must be positive; a refund is not a negative payment. Every payment must name a currency, either explicitly or from the thread.
  `statement` counts billed time from `hours`; entries with no currency are ignored by it.
  --pdf requires --thread and needs client_name on the thread file to render.
  ID is the 8-hex-char payment id shown by `list`; ids share one namespace with `hours`.
  `rm` prompts for confirmation unless -y is given.
